task.title: Crash recovery hardening for foundation-backed commands
task.summary_zh: 補 runtime-manager kill-switch 與 foundation-backed command 的 crash-window recovery/idempotency/audit 硬化與回歸測試。
acceptance: crash replay does not duplicate side effect
partial durable state recovers or quarantines with audit
shared foundation replay primitives are used
task.next: Owner finalized approved task after Codex review. Delivery commit 462394a hardens foundation-backed kill-switch crash recovery; verification: pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_governance_command_submission.py services/runtime-manager/test_runtime_manager.py services/foundation/tests -q => 64 passed.
review_notes_zh: 已重跑指定驗證套件並核對 optional-binding REPLACE crash replay 修復；runtime-manager 透過 shared foundation command recovery/idempotency primitives 恢復 executing ledger，避免 PAUSE/REPLACE replay 重複 side effect，corrupt partial state 會留下 quarantine audit。

handoffs.message: Implemented crash recovery hardening for runtime-manager kill-switch: durable reserved/executing/succeeded idempotency ledger, shared foundation command recovery/quarantine helpers, replay resume without duplicate binding side effect, and corrupt partial-state audit quarantine. Verification: pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_governance_command_submission.py services/runtime-manager/test_runtime_manager.py services/foundation/tests -q => 62 passed.

Changes requested: REPLACE kill-switch replay can duplicate fallback replacement binding after crash between replacement create and old-binding retire. See docs/reviews/2026-04-28-sd-fnd-005-codex-review.md.

Fixed REPLACE kill-switch replay idempotency by reusing an existing ks-replace replacement binding before retiring the old binding; added regression for crash after replacement create before old-binding retire. Verification: pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_governance_command_submission.py services/runtime-manager/test_runtime_manager.py services/foundation/tests -q => 63 passed.

Changes requested by Codex: optional-binding REPLACE crash replay still fails. Replay rebuilds durable command as SimpleNamespace without binding_id and raises AttributeError instead of recovering/quarantining; see docs/reviews/2026-04-28-sd-fnd-005-codex-review.md. Existing target suite still passes: 63 passed.

Fixed optional-binding REPLACE crash replay: durable command replay restores omitted optional fields and recovers old binding from ks-replace replacement.rollback_parent before active-binding fallback. Regression added; verification: pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_governance_command_submission.py services/runtime-manager/test_runtime_manager.py services/foundation/tests -q => 64 passed.

Codex review approved. Evidence: docs/reviews/2026-04-28-sd-fnd-005-codex-review.md; verification: pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_governance_command_submission.py services/runtime-manager/test_runtime_manager.py services/foundation/tests -q => 64 passed.
